  "name": "Claire Lomas",
  "age": 44,
  "cause_of_death": "Accident in Jordan on 22 August",
  "residence": "Melton, Leicestershire",
  "background": "Paralysed from the chest down following a riding accident at the Osberton Horse Trials in 2007, which caused multiple injuries including a broken neck, back, ribs, and a punctured lung.",
  "achievements": [
    "Completed the 2012 London Marathon in 17 days using a bionic suit",
    "Lit the Paralympic cauldron in Trafalgar Square in 2012 in the presence of then-Prime Minister David Cameron and Mayor of London Boris Johnson",
    "Participated in the 2016 Great North Run while pregnant, finishing in five days using her bionic suit",
    "Raised nearly £1 million for charity through various events across the UK"
  ],
  "additional_info": "Was initially denied a place in the Vitality London 10k but joined the half marathon instead.",
  "family_statement": "Expressed devastation over her loss and requested privacy to grieve."
}
```
